subject: Elmbridge implementation canvas & kickoff coordination
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Elmbridge — Handoff: implementation canvas and tech notes

Team — quick handoff for Elmbridge (deal id D-2027-ELM-042). Closing summary: annual committed Dedicated capacity, private deployment (VPC), prioritized SLA (99.9 p95 target) — signed yesterday. High-level goals: 1) pilot ingestion of clinical transcripts + embeddings for search, 2) production inference for chat triage in 3 months. Go-live target: 2027-06-15 (pilot -> 2027-05-20).

Key items I want on the record: 
- Customer expects data to remain in us-west-2 (legal/regulatory).
- They requested on-premise-like control: Private deployment with customer-managed VPC peering, KMS integration for keys.
- Initial models: preference for a 7B open model (cost), but willing to test a larger variant if quality/regression requires it.

Attachments included: Elmbridge_SOW_v1.2.pdf (SOW + milestones), elmbridge_network_diagram.png (network team diagram), security_questionnaire_elmbridge.docx (completed but incomplete bits highlighted).

Primary external contacts: Lena Ortiz (Director of Data + ML) — lena.ortiz@elmbridge.com; Carlos Mendez (Infra) — carlos.mendez@elmbridge.com. They asked for a kickoff week of Apr 11–15, preferably in the mornings PT.

Asks for CS & Eng: 
- Assign PM/owner for onboarding and lead for tech intake (who will run the kickoff).
- Validate SOW milestones and confirm the 6-week pilot window and 4-week production cutover runway.
- Review security questionnaire gaps and confirm evidence we can supply for SOC2 items.

Internal notes (sensitive): we committed a 20% discount for first year to land Dedicated capacity. Sales is still carrying a small credit note for proof-of-concept usage. Please flag if this impacts margin or requires rev ops sign-off.

Ben
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elmbridge — Handoff: implementation canvas and tech notes

Thanks Ben — assigning Marissa to lead the customer kickoff and overall onboarding cadence. Marissa, can you confirm you can take ownership and set the kickoff for Apr 12 (09:30 PT) — I'll block an hour and invite the customer.

Initial responses / gaps we need to resolve before kickoff:
- SOW: I will review milestones. Quick ask: confirm the acceptance criteria for the pilot (what metrics denote "pilot success"). Ben, please add a short bullet for success criteria in HubSpot if you haven't already.
- Security questionnaire: looks like they left the encryption-at-rest details blank. Vivek — can your team provide the KMS/HSM integration checklist and an expected timeline for key exchange?
- Network: their diagram shows a non-standard NAT/Proxy layer. We'll need infra to validate ports for gRPC and S3 egress. Vivek, can you triage with Carlos on required firewall rules and whether we need a customer VPC appliance?
- Data residency: confirm us-west-2 is supported for Private deployment; if we need a separate region, note the delta in cost/time.

Action items (owner listed):
- Marissa: Lead kickoff scheduling, finalize pilot acceptance criteria, owner matrix, and weekly status template. (Due Apr 8)
- Vivek: Technical intake doc (ports, peering steps, KMS flow, expected latency targets) + quick feasibility on mounting kv-cache behavior for customer data patterns. (Due Apr 6)
- Ben: Confirm internal discount routing and flag RevOps if necessary; please forward the signed SOW to Legal/RevOps. (Due Apr 2)

I will prepare a kickoff agenda that includes: introductions, scope review, technical intake, security checklist review, and next-step commitments.

Sofia
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elmbridge — Handoff: implementation canvas and tech notes

Quick technical notes — high level feasibility check before kickoff: 

1) Private deployment in us-west-2: supported. We have reserved capacity options there; provisioning timeline ~2–3 weeks from signed SOW to baseline environment, longer if they require dedicated racks or an on-prem appliance.

2) Network & peering: gRPC and HTTPS egress for model serving + S3 access for artifacts. Ports we need opened: 443 (TLS), 8443 (runtime), and ephemeral for peering (we'll provide list). Customer NAT/proxy means we should test an initial handshake window. Carlos — please share any proxy headers or TLS inspection policies that could mangle GRPC streams.

3) KMS/HSM: We can integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS) and accept re-encryption handshake. We'll need customer-generated IAM role and a rotated key alias for production. Timeline: KMS proof-of-concept within 1 week after kickoff if customer can provision the IAM role quickly.

4) Model selection & inference profile: start with a quantized 7B variant for pilot (cost lane). If quality regressions appear, we recommend staged rollout to a 13B variant in Dedicated for peak traffic. We'll present metric thresholds (latency p95 < 250ms, coherence/baseline eval pass rate > 85%) for pilot.

5) Observability & rollout: we will enable per-route tracing in the Console and require sample prompts for our Eval pipeline before any rollout. Please ask Lena for a deck of representative prompts and a small evaluation corpus (~200 prompts).

I'll draft a technical intake template and attach it to the kickoff invite. Any blockers from legal/ops (keys, region controls, contract language around data residency), flag now.

-Vivek
Director, Platform Eng — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@elmbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@elmbridge.com>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elmbridge — Handoff: implementation canvas and tech notes

Thanks for the quick coordination and congrats on the signing. Marissa & Sofia — we can confirm Apr 12 at 09:30 PT for the kickoff; that works for the leadership and infra groups.

A few answers to accelerate prep: 
- Pilot success criteria: 1) document retrieval + embeddings recall @ top-5 >= 78% on our clinical test set, 2) triage chat latency p95 < 350ms on pilot traffic, 3) no PII leakage on sampled outputs. We'll share the evaluation corpus by Apr 4.
- On encryption: we'll provide an AWS IAM role and KMS alias; Carlos will provide the NAT/proxy config and firewall rules. Expect that from us by Apr 6.
- Security questionnaire: attached is a completed form — there are a couple of items where we noted "TBD" pending your SOC2 evidence. Happy to walk through them on kickoff. (See security_questionnaire_elmbridge.docx)

We appreciate clarity on rollback policy — can you include your canary rollout / fallback plan in the kickoff deck? We want to ensure the triage product never degrades core clinician workflows.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff. 

Lena Ortiz
Director of Data + ML, Elmbridge Therapeutics
lena.ortiz@elmbridge.com

Attachments: security_questionnaire_elmbridge.docx
